newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danske Bank denies rumoured Swedish merger.
newsitem.headline: Danske Bank denies rumoured Swedish merger.

text.p: Denmark's biggest banking group Den Danske Bank on Wednesday denied market rumours that it was negotiating to merge with or take over Sweden's Nordbanken.
"There is absolutely no truth in any reports that we should be negotiating or anything like that with anybody," Den Danske Bank CEO Knud Soerensen told Reuters.

Soerensen said that it was Den Danske's clear aim to extend its position in the Swedish market through its own branch office there but would not rule out that it could one day be interested in acquiring a Swedish bank.
